generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government /Government of India / Union Territory.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per e-portal.
The tender is of two cover system.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted in Tender Schedule-B (Financial Bid) in the website itself.
For those tenderers whose Technical bids satisfy the eligibility criteria and who has furnished all the necessary documents, only their financial Bids will be opened.
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the tenderer should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such tenderer shall be forfeited. The registration of such tenderer shall also be cancelled.
Right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons rests with the accepting authority.
The successful bidders shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The contractor shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers working in this area.

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes), levies, duties and Cess, building worker welfare Cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT.
The Bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rates as issued by the PF Department from time to time.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy26 PPT 2022 dtd: 26.04.2022.
KPCL shall recover the Income tax etc., at the prevailing applicable rates.

The successful bidder should strictly adhere & ensure the minimum wages Act to the labours prevailing as per the Govt. rules & regulations. The bidder should maintain register of labour deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority and remittance towards PF shall commensurate with the labour component for the work involved.
Contractor should have independents PF Code. The Contractor shall remit PF of labourers to contractors permanent PF code Number only and Not to the KPCL PF Sub Code.
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day shall be reckoned.
If the contractor makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.
Further details of the work can be obtained in the office of the Executive Engineer (PCM)-2, KPCL, RTPS, Shaktinagar - 584170, during office hours.
The tender Notification along with Blank Tender Form will be accessible in the e-procurement website (www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in).
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in.
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only.
In case the agency fails to execute the work properly, engineer may entrust the work to the other agency at the cost and risk of original agency.
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the last date of submission of bid.
All labourers Police verification is to be carried out by the contractor & same to be submitted for gate passes and cost is also to be borne by the contractor.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute the complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval competent authority

Contract Performance Guarantee: The successful bidder has to furnish e-Bank Guarantee from the banks which are integrated with NeSL or DD/NEFT from Nationalised/Scheduled Bank for an amount equivalent to 5% of contract value with an appropriate validity period within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of Intent (LOI). The e-Bank Guarantee (e-BG)/DD shall be furnished in the prescribed format only. The work Performance shall be 120 months after completing the work. The total contract period is One Hundred and Twenty Four (124) Months (i.e. 04 months completion period & 120 months Guarantee period). The Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG) will be released only after the satisfactory completion of total contract.

technicalCriterionList.description: PQR-1: Any reputed individual/Company having valid KPWD contractor registration certificate of Class III & above are eligible for participation for which scanned copy of the same shall be uploaded

PQR-2: Work Experience: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor, at least one similar nature of work such as Providing Water Proofing with TPO/APP membrane of value not less than Rs.36.91 Lakhs in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the Technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

PQR-3: Minimum quantity: The intending eligible bidders as indicated in PQR (1 & 2) should have satisfactorily executed a minimum of 3113.00 Sqm of TPO/APP membrane work in any one year for continuous period of 12 Months in in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25, 2025-26). In proof of the same, the work done certificate indicating the quantity executed issued by an officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL/RPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer/Competent Authority in case of State/ Central Government/Government under taking/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Thermal Power Station in India as the case shall be uploaded.

PQR-4: Financial Turnover: The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of value not less than Rs.73.82 Lakhs during the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder shall submit certified copy of the turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant for the respective two years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

PQR-5: Assessed available tender capacity, Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria in Para no.1, 2, 3 & 4 of PQRs, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity A x N x 2.5-B should be greater than the amount put to tender, were A is maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years updated to 2026-27 price level taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N-Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited for 04 months. B -Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 04 Months (0.33 months) (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited). Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on- going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent or self-declaration documents are to be uploaded for which Format is included in the Bid document.

PQR-6: Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 18. 76 Lakhs Credit lines/letter of credit/certificates from Nationalized Banks/Scheduled Banks for meeting the fund requirement etc.,.shall be uploaded.

The Bidders should upload the following declarations by duly signed, I/we shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by KPCL or by any State Government or Government of India/ Union Territory. I/we declare that EMD has not been forfeited and none of my contracts have been terminated or foreclosed on account of default in KPCL or elsewhere during the past Three years. My/our offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. I/we have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. I/we shall pay fair and reasonable wages, which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by GOK to the labours/workmen employed in the contract. I/we have accepted the condition that KPCL reserves the right to foreclose the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing water proof treatment using Thermoplastic Polyolefin (TPO) membranes over the roof of Unit-2,6 & 8 ESP Control room,AHP auxiliary buildings for Unit-5 to 8,Unit-8 Battery room and PRDS floor of Unit-2 at RTPS

itemList.description: Removing damaged water proofing treatment over the roof such as top layer of pre granular bitumen felt and bitumenous coat or any other water proof course by using light tools like chisels etc., without distrubing / damaging bottom layer of concrete including disposing off the debris as directed etc., complete with all lead and lifts.

Providing Waterproof treatment to the cracks using 1 coat of bondcoat of SBR latex and Cement at the ratio 1:1 and then preparing Cement Mortar of 1:3 admixed with SBR latex at a dosage of 15% of Cement. SBR latex confirming to BS 6319 part 2:1983 & ASTM C 190-85. Cure for 5 days. Apply singlecomponent, cold applied, water based acrylic and UV resistant water proofing & protector conforming to ASTM D 412-1992 & ASTM E 1980-01. The surface shall be prepared free of dust, fungus, loose & hard particles etc. The cracks are sealed with crack x-shrink free sealing paste as per direction of Engineer in charge

Providing & applying SBR Latex bonding agent followed by providing & applying ready mix polymer mortar by trowel to rectify surface undulation wherever necessary to get need surface. Including cost of materials, labours, transportation etc complete as per specification and as direct by the Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and installing TPO single side Fleece back Membrane, Membrane shall be high performance, heat weldable, thermoplastic polyolefin (TPO) sheet, manufactured & supplied in specified thickness of 1.2mm, designed for waterproofing and heat shielding roofs of new and existing buildings, with puncture resistance of 57 LBF ASTM D 751, breaking strength 125 LBF ASTM D751 tear strength 30 LBF ASTM D 751 procedure B, high peel strength of seam joints and heat welds, Chlorine free, plasticizer free, phthalate free. Environmentally friendly and safe for humans, Exceptional resistance to heat, UV, Ozone, bacteria, chemical, acid corrosion, Resistance to root penetration, suitable for green roofs, Continuous serviceability from minus 30 degree celsius to 100 degree celsiuswithout cracking, tearing or brittleness failure, 100% recyclable. Shall be applied over the well prepared surface by applying cementitious adhesive for the roof, high performance adhesive over the wall surface and at back side of the Single side TPO membrane, supported with mechanical anchors, lapping of membrane for width of 75mm by hot air welding including grinding sharp edges at the substrate, cleaning the substrate to make them free from all contaminants, pretreating all the pipe penetrations by installing a layer of Single side Fleece membrane; Approved by CFTRI, etc., complete with all lead and lifts, complete as per specification and direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and Applying PU based Elastomeric Liquid Applied PU Waterproofing Membrane single component, cold applied, water based acrylic PU dispersion with highly elastic and UV resistant water proofing treatment to the Existing Roof surface/Chajjas/Sunken portion of WC:Bathroom applied @ 1.2 l/per m2, having tensile strength greater than 1.5N/mm2, elongation greater than 300% with solid content not less than 60% in 2 coats including surface preparation, priming the surface with water based acrylic primer @0.1 l/m2, and spreading 60 gsm geotextile between two top coats completely as per specification. The finished cost to include surface preparation, making coving at Junction, Bore Packing, treatment of construction joints completely as per specification.

Providng 5 cm thick screed concrete over the existing portion CC 1:2:4 propn. Using 10 mm and down size approved clean, hard, graded aggregates with 2% water proof compound ,including mixing, laying, tamping, curing, smooth finishing to proper slope and cut to the required pattern if necessary etc., complete with all leads & lifts, complete as per specification and direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and laying with 1.0 mm thick FPO membrane to seal the expansion joint. The tape having mechanical properties like, Elongation more than 500 percent, Tensile Strength more than12N/mm2, Tear Strength more than 200N, Water tightness 400 kPa/72hrs confirming to DIN EN 1928 B. Ensure that apply Two part Epoxy Adhesive @ 1.4kg/m to get 1 2mm thick on the prepared surface before placing the tape and after placing seal with same epoxy adhesive which having Bond Strength with concrete 1.5N/mm2, Compressive Strength @ 7 days, equal or more than 45N/mm2 as per BS 6319 Part 2, Tensile Strength @ 7 days, equal or more than18N/mm2 as per BS 6319 Part 7, Shear Strength @ 7 days, equal or more than 8N/mm2 as per BS 6319 Part 4, Flexural Strength @ 7 days, N/mm2 as per BS 6319 Part 3. The finished cost including surface preparation, filling foam backer rod, applying masking tape on both sides of the joint & polysulphide sealant filling on gap completely as per specification

Providing and fixing on wall face unplasticised Rigid PVC rain water pipes conforming to IS : 13592 Type A, including jointing with seal ring conforming to IS : 5382, leaving 10 mm gap for thermal expansion, (i) Single socketed pipes 100 mm diameter.
